body.name: PT and SC observed-data ATT functionals
body.construction:
With \(C_b\) from \(\mathrm{def{:}branch\text{-}conditional\text{-}contrasts}\), define
\[
 \nu_x=P_O(X=x\mid G=1)=\frac{p_X(x)p_1(x)}{\pi_1},
 \qquad
 \theta_b(P_O)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\nu_x C_b(x),
 \qquad b\in\{\mathrm{PT},\mathrm{SC}\}.
\]
Thus \(\theta_{\mathrm{PT}}\) and \(\theta_{\mathrm{SC}}\) are the two indexed cases. These are observed-law functionals. Their equality to the causal ATT is a conclusion under the corresponding branch restriction, not part of this definition.
